title: Cantilever, end load
description: Steel bar 200 x 20 x 20 mm, end x = 0 fixed, 1000 N down (-z) spread over the free end x = 200.

quantities.label: Tip deflection (centre of the free end, -z)
quantities.citation: Timoshenko & Gere, Mechanics of Materials (beam deflection; with shear: d = PL^3/3EI + PL/(kGA), k = 5/6 for a rectangle), edition/section to be checked; Cowper, J. Appl. Mech. 33 (1966) 335-340 (shear coefficient)
quantities.tolerance_reason: Beam theory and 3D elasticity differ by a few tenths of a percent at L/h = 10; the rest of the band covers the mesh error.
